speaker: A26U4IKXMXT0ZA

text: Fantastic! What is an amount you are comfortable donating?

text: Is this a mutual donation, from both of us.  Or do you represent the charity?

speaker: A26U4IKXMXT0ZA
text: I am representing the charity and I am hoping that you will consider donating directly from your task payment. You can choose any amount from $0 to $2. Of course, Your $2 would make the most difference to these neglected children.

speaker: A2E8RFKIOY2MQR
text: I am willing to donate $1.  That seems to be fair to all.

speaker: A26U4IKXMXT0ZA
text: Thank you so much for your generosity! The children of our organization will be so fortunate and happy to receive this. So many of these children are living in war zones in undeveloped countries. They face violence every day. 1,000 children were killed in the first 2 months of 2018. If you consider increasing your donation to $2, this will help DOUBLE the amount of children and our charity will match your donation at that level!

speaker: A2E8RFKIOY2MQR
text: I think I will stick to the $1.  That would make me happy to help.

speaker: A26U4IKXMXT0ZA
text: We are so happy that you are helping as well. The children will really benefit from this. Last year, many children died from hunger because we did not get enough donations to fully feed their families. Even small amounts of change can mean the difference between life or death for the little ones. Is there any way you could consider going to $1.50? I just spoke with my manager and wonderful news! She said the charity would STILL be willing to match if you go up just that small increment!

speaker: A2E8RFKIOY2MQR
text: I love helping the children.  If you would consider the matching that amount of the $1, that would double the donation of $2 .

speaker: A26U4IKXMXT0ZA
text: I will have to check with my manager. In the meantime, can I confirm your donation of $1 to our charity?

speaker: A2E8RFKIOY2MQR
